description: Calculates what an amount in another currency is worth in USD at Futuur's latest exchange rates. It only calculates; nothing is exchanged and no balance changes. Use it to show a USD equivalent for a balance or a stake in USDC, USDT, EUR, BTC, ETH and other quoted currencies (see get_exchange_rates for the list). Play money (OOM) has no USD value. Returns the converted amount, the USD rate used and when the rates were updated.

value.description: Amount of the source currency to convert, greater than 0.

name: convert_to_usd
title: Convert amount to USD
